WEB-1001 (S2). The fourth question, ‘How do I add tasks by voice?’ / «¿Cómo añado tareas hablando?» / «Com afegeixo tasques parlant?», answers that you can ‘move, change or delete a task by voice’ and ends ‘your words are sent to Google to be turned into tasks’. Since 2026-10-21 the app also marks a task done by voice («ya he llamado al dentista») and moves, changes, completes or deletes a whole set from one sentence («pasa todo lo de ayer a mañana»): one card shows the change first, and one «Deshacer» undoes all of it (`.claude/ux-review/DECISIONS.md:5-20`; `Backend/docs/VOICE_COMMANDS.md:161-219`). A visitor reading ‘a task’ concludes it's one at a time. Keep the answer's first three sentences and replace the last two.

The whole answer becomes (`faq.items[3].answer` at `src/content/site/en.ts:104`, `es.ts:104`, `ca.ts:110`): EN `Tap Add a task and say what you need to do, in your own words; several things at once is fine. Tap Done, and TaskFlow shows one task for each, with its day and time. Add them all with one tap. You can also ask what you have this week, or move, change, complete or delete tasks by voice, even all of yesterday’s at once. TaskFlow shows the change first, and you can undo it. It needs the internet: your words are sent to Google.` / ES `Toca Añadir tarea y di lo que tienes que hacer, con tus palabras; puedes decir varias cosas a la vez. Toca Listo y TaskFlow te muestra una tarea por cada cosa, con su día y su hora. Añádelas todas con un toque. También puedes preguntar qué tienes esta semana, o mover, cambiar, completar o eliminar tareas hablando, incluso todas las de ayer a la vez. TaskFlow te enseña el cambio antes y puedes deshacerlo. Necesita internet: tus palabras se envían a Google.` / CA `Toca Afegeix una tasca i digues el que has de fer, amb les teves paraules; pots dir diverses coses alhora. Toca Fet i TaskFlow et mostra una tasca per cada cosa, amb el dia i l’hora. Afegeix-les totes amb un toc. També pots preguntar què tens aquesta setmana, o moure, canviar, completar o suprimir tasques parlant, fins i tot totes les d’ahir alhora. TaskFlow t’ensenya el canvi abans i el pots desfer. Necessita internet: les teves paraules s’envien a Google.` The Catalan is the reviewer's; it needs a native read.

Why these words: move, change and delete are the ones the answer already uses, as the app's card does (ES «Eliminar», CA «Suprimeix»); ‘complete’ / «completar» is the app's task action (`complete`, `App/lib/l10n/app_es.arb:165`, `app_ca.arb:144`) and the offline answer's word. The longest sentence drops from 28 to 24 words; the English answer goes from 84 to 85 words. Keep the question as it is. Don't add a spoken example (a visitor would try it in the live demo, which only adds tasks, and lose a try), and don't quote the app's bulk card.

TaskFlow puede recordarte las tareas con fecha: te lo pregunta una sola vez.` / CA `Mira les tasques per dia, setmana o mes, al costat dels esdeveniments dels calendaris del telèfon si vols. TaskFlow et pot recordar les tasques amb data: t’ho pregunta una sola vegada.` The first sentence is unchanged; the Catalan second sentence is the reviewer's and needs a native read.

decisions.question: Show changing many tasks at once by voice (‘move all of yesterday’s tasks to tomorrow’) anywhere beyond the FAQ's voice answer? For example one sentence on the ‘Say several things at once’ card, or a second example under the hero.
decisions.recommendation: Not now. WP53 already puts it in the FAQ's voice answer (‘…even all of yesterday’s at once’), where a visitor who wonders finds it. For: it's the newest capability, you asked for it yourself, and it's what someone comparing apps would switch for. Against: the hero and the cards teach the first loop (say it, and it's on your calendar) to a newcomer who has no tasks to change yet; the live demo only adds tasks, so it can't show it; and the app's /ux review of the bulk card is still running. Revisit after that review and the test with your father.
decisions.answer: «Yes, on the card»: one sentence on the ‘Say several things at once’ card says that voice can also move or finish many tasks at once, as in ‘move all of yesterday’s tasks to tomorrow’. The hero stays as it is; the FAQ's voice answer still names it too (WP53). Built by WP57 (WEB-1004).

decisions.question: Tell visitors about the other ways into TaskFlow: sharing a message from another app such as WhatsApp (it opens a task with the message's day and time already read, D3 of 2026-10-20), the home-screen widget («Dictate a task») and the launcher shortcuts?

decisions.answer: «Yes, briefly»: one short line or one FAQ answer names the home-screen widget, the launcher shortcuts and sharing a message from another app such as WhatsApp, each as the app names it in that language. Built by WP57 (WEB-1005) as the FAQ's last item.
